title: Tube-free Agar Overlays: Rapid Plaque Assays with Fewer Steps and Materials
author: Kathryn Kauffman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j8ncrve
materials: Equilibrate the top agar to 50-52°C: Place the beaker-waterbath containing the bottle of molten top agar and stirbar onto a hot plate and activate gentle stirring, place a thermometer into the beaker-waterbath and leave it there to wait for equilibration to 50-52°C (Figure 1). a Figure 1. Top agar bottle equilibrated in beaker-waterbath. Note: This will require setting the heat block to a temperature greater than the target temperature, for example up to 85°C, but this is dependent on specific heat block models and must be determined by the user.

steps.title: Prepare beaker-waterbath
steps.instruction: Place the bottle of top agar into a glass beaker and fill the beaker with water up to the level of the top agar in the bottle (e.g., a 500 ml bottle in a 1l beaker).

steps.title: Melt the top agar
steps.instruction: Microwave the beaker-waterbath to achieve a 'smooth melt' of the top agar, ensuring the bottle lid is slightly loose for venting.

substeps.instruction: Melt top agar for several 5-minute cycles at low % power until nearly completely melted.
Increase % power and cook until the top agar comes to a boil; bring to a boil 3 times, observing closely to prevent boil-over.
Remove the bottle from the microwave using heat-safe gloves, ensuring the bottle is not swirled during removal to avoid burns from sudden boil-over.

steps.title: Add host culture
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 ul of overnight host culture directly onto the bottom agar.

steps.title: Add virus
steps.instruction: Pipette 10-100 ul of virus-containing solution directly into the host droplet on the bottom agar.

steps.title: Apply molten top agar
steps.instruction: Using sterile technique and a 5 ml or serological pipette, briefly remove the lid of the top agar bottle and pipette 2 ml of molten top agar directly onto the bottom agar next to the host and virus droplets.

steps.title: Create overlay
steps.instruction: Swirl the plate vigorously but briefly to mix the bacteria, virus, and molten top agar and spread the mixture across the plate.

steps.title: Set and incubate
steps.instruction: Allow the plate to sit on the bench, top agar side up, for at least 20 minutes to solidify completely, then place in desired incubation conditions to monitor for plaque formation.
